summary:
Main
Prices recovered to some extent, but the rebound was not uniform. DCE most-traded closed at 672.5 yuan/mt, up 0.15%.The seaborne 61% and 65% indices rose 0.68% and 0.23% to USD 89.40 and 107.75/dmt, respectively, while all 12 brand quotations increased. Most port products rose 2 yuan/wmt, but Carajas Fines fell 8 yuan and PB Lump was unchanged.
